pills.title: Zone complaint during plant drift
triggers: Comfort complaint while kW/RT is above baseline
discounted_signals: One warm afternoon after a public holiday start-up
Single afternoon spike in kW/RT during September
never_do: Never lower the building-wide setpoint for a single-zone complaint

trade_offs.opt-inspect-vav: Low effort, no plant energy impact; fixes comfort only.
trade_offs.opt-resequence-chillers: Recovers plant efficiency; needs an approved band and a short load shift.
trade_offs.opt-setpoint-drop: Fixes the zone but raises plant kWh across every other zone.

escalation.safety: Odour, illness, or any cooling-tower result above limit -> duty engineer before any LLM call.
escalation.out_of_band_setpoint: Any setpoint outside the approved band -> escalate.

claims.text: A single-zone complaint is usually downstream of the plant, not caused by it.
